name: platformd-port-forward
description: GitHub Action for short-lived platformd TCP port forwards

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=cjs --minify-whitespace --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/cleanup-entry.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=cjs --minify-whitespace --outfile=dist/cleanup/index.js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist
